purpose: Introduce a contrast or a gentle reservation.
keywords: Sentence + だけど; noun / な-adjective + だけど
Tomorrow is a day off, but I am going to the office.
That shop is convenient, but a little expensive.
I want to go. But I do not have time today.
formation: Sentence + だけど; noun / な-adjective + だけど
restrictions: At sentence start, it responds to a previous statement.
mistake: With verbs and い-adjectives inside a sentence use けど rather than attaching だけど directly.
